# E0350: a remap maps a value twice

Each arm of a remap table maps one source value; two arms for the same value
would have to agree. Write each value once.

## Example

`ship/history/0.0.thema`:

```cue
schema: {
	kind: "a" | "b"
}
```

`ship/1.0.thema`:

```cue
schema: {
	kind: 1 | 2
}

ForwardLens: {
	v0_0: _
	v1_0: {
		kind: remap(v0_0.kind, {
			"a": 1
			"a": 2
			"b": 2
		})
	}
}
```

thema reports:

```
error[E0350]: remap maps "a" twice
  --> 1.0.thema:10:4
   |
10 |             "a": 2
   |             ^^^
   |
```
